name: Moji — Markdown reader landing page by Moji
description: A desktop-app landing page built on an editorial, Japanese-inflected design language: large serif headlines, seal-stamp kanji badges sectioning the page, and a warm paper-beige base that alternates with near-black sections for rhythm. Product proof comes from dark app-window screenshots with small floating labels, and the palette is almost entirely monochrome with a single crimson accent reserved for underlines, seal stamps and CTAs. Density stays low — one idea per band — until the download section compresses into three platform cards.
